name: pipeline_benzene
purpose: TASKS 146, build step 4 (step 3 ran it into pipeline_benzene_2026-10-29): the pipeline end to end on benzene from its SMILES with the network's ΔH saved (correction.npz) and the live certificate written beside the result (m08/live_certificate.py), checked against corpus benzene (A_8448043181, probes/pipeline_vs_corpus.py) and against its export certificate (module 08 tests)
command: env CORPUS_QC_PYTHON=C:/Users/thebr/.conda/envs/qc/python.exe PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m m08.pipeline --name benzene --smiles c1ccccc1 --out ../../probes/results_m1/pipeline_benzene_certified_2026-10-29 --threads 6 --psi4-memory-gb 4 --wsl-cap-mb 6144

estimate.basis: the analytic B3LYP Hessian of benzene took 465 s on 16 threads (analytic_hessians.py, 11 Oct 2026); about three times that on 6 laptop threads, plus the psi4 optimisation (minutes on 2 threads, 29 Oct 11:2x)

memory.basis: a bound: the WSL step runs under probes/wsl_capped.sh at 6144 MB (pyscf max_memory 5560); psi4 is given 4 GB and runs before it, not beside it; the network step loads three 1.2 MB-class checkpoints
